description: Composite policy requiring ALL of: age >= 18, credential not revoked, issuer in trusted set, and holder possesses a specific capability claim. Demonstrates boolean AND composition across heterogeneous claim-graph constraints.
notes: AND nodes evaluate children left-to-right; with strategy=short_circuit the first failing child fails the whole policy.
The nested AND under the capability branch groups the two capability-specific checks so they short-circuit together before the outer AND continues.
issuer_in resolves the trusted set once per evaluation and reuses it for all sibling issuer_in nodes.
freshness uses claim issuance time, not evaluation time, to avoid clock-skew false negatives.
